about.headline: Our Story
about.subtitle: Basketball as a force for community — rooted in Pattaya.
about.founderBio: Alex Dovey is a basketball coach from Denver with years of coaching and playing experience. Driven by a love of the game and a belief that sport builds real community, Alex is bringing grassroots basketball to Pattaya — creating something for everyone, not just the elite.
about.why1Desc: Basketball shouldn't be reserved for elite programs. We build pathways for every player, at every level.
about.why2Desc: Sport is how communities grow. Every session, every league, every connection — that's the mission.
about.why3Desc: Pattaya is a city full of energy and potential. Grass Roots Sports is here to channel that into something lasting.
about.comingDesc: We are in the final stages of bringing Grass Roots Sports to life in Pattaya, Thailand. Follow us on Instagram to stay up to date on our launch.

programs.headline: Our Programs
programs.subtitle: Built for every level, every age. Launching in Pattaya soon.
programs.youthDesc: The perfect starting point. We teach fundamentals, build confidence, and make the game fun for young players just finding their feet.
programs.teenDesc: Step up your game. Skill development, team play, and competitive preparation for serious young athletes who want to go further.
programs.adultDesc: Organised leagues and pickup games for adults of all skill levels. Show up, play hard, and be part of something real.
programs.privateDesc: One-on-one sessions tailored to your specific goals — from first-timers learning the basics to experienced players levelling up.
programs.notifyDesc: Programs are launching soon. Follow us on Instagram for dates, pricing, and registration details.
